need: The desktop CRM navigation rail must remain stationary in the viewport while the membership queue and selected dossier content scroll independently.
negativeBoundary: Do not freeze the complete CRM page, introduce nested horizontal overflow, or replace the existing responsive mobile navigation behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The desktop left navigation rail keeps the same viewport position while the CRM content is scrolled vertically.
The membership queue and selected dossier remain fully scrollable without being covered by the rail or header.
The responsive CRM navigation behavior remains usable below the desktop breakpoint.

accepts: Keep the desktop CRM navigation rail fixed within the viewport while operational content scrolls.
Preserve the current rail width, visual grammar and responsive navigation behavior.
rejects: Let the left navigation rail move vertically with the long membership dossier.
Freeze all CRM content or introduce a second document-level horizontal scrollbar.
